description: This module allows setting/accumulating stats on the current ansible run, either per host or for all hosts in the run.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: Whether the provided value is aggregated to the existing stat true or will replace it false. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A dictionary of which each key represents a stat (or variable) you want to keep track of.

parameters.name: per_host
parameters.description: Whether the stats are per host or for all hosts in the run. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Aggregating packages_installed stat per host
  ansible.builtin.set_stats:
    data:
      packages_installed: 31
    per_host: yes

- name: Aggregating random stats for all hosts using complex arguments
  ansible.builtin.set_stats:
    data:
      one_stat: 11
      other_stat: "{{ local_var * 2 }}"
      another_stat: "{{ some_registered_var.results | map(attribute='ansible_facts.some_fact') | list }}"
    per_host: no

- name: Setting stats (not aggregating)
  ansible.builtin.set_stats:
    data:
      the_answer: 42
    aggregate: no
